content_record.title: historical-2025-phase-separated-translation-hubs-dock-onto-mitochondria-to-extend-life-a6c04d9c
content_record.editorial_body: In C. elegans, LARP-1 forms liquid droplets that synthesize key mitochondrial proteins on-site. Keeping these droplets attached during aging preserves cristae and ATP, boosting longevity. Three things to remember - LARP-1 droplets (MATOs) dock to mitochondria via TOM complex. - Local synthesis of MIC60 and ATP-2 maintains cristae and ATP. - Persistent MATOs during aging extend lifespan in worms. Source This signal is based on Mitochondria-associated condensates maintain mitochondrial homeostasis and promote lifespan. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Findings in C. elegans; human relevance unproven.
